description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Boolient is a venture-backed healthtech company that provides software solutions and services to healthcare providers. The Software Engineer will design, build, and ship healthcare technology features involving data pipelines, AI- and SQL-driven analytics, full-stack applications, and cloud infrastructure.
Software engineer building healthcare data pipelines, AI-driven analytics, and full-stack cloud applications

Responsibilities:
• Build High-Throughput Data Pipelines: Help build and optimize robust parsers and ingestion engines for complex healthcare data formats
• Develop AI & SQL-Driven Analytics: Assist in building deep analytics engines that combine classical database optimization with modern AI-assisted workflows to automate complex denial resolutions and financial predictions
• Ship Full-Stack Solutions: Design, build, and maintain sleek, highly responsive UI interfaces backed by robust microservices and APIs
• Support Cloud Infrastructure: Help manage and deploy applications across multi-cloud environments, leveraging GCP and AWS
• Leverage Modern AI Tooling: Maximize your development speed using modern AI-assisted coding tools while upholding strong standards for code quality, system architecture, and performance

Requirements:
• You hold a degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) or have hands-on project/internship experience building software systems
• You have solid fundamentals in backend engineering (databases, basic data parsing, API development) paired with a desire to build clean, intuitive UI components
• Basic familiarity with SQL, database design, and cloud platform concepts across GCP or AWS
• You actively embrace AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate your learning and output while building a solid grasp of underlying software engineering fundamentals
• Solid proficiency in Python, including coursework, projects, or professional experience using web frameworks like Django, Flask, or FastAPI. Understanding of ORMs, databases, and background execution
• Basic knowledge of Postgres or relational databases, including basic schema design, and query writing
• Exposure to building data ingestion, validation, or transformation scripts
• 0–2 years of software engineering experience (including internships, co-ops, or personal projects) with a strong desire to learn and contribute to production code
• You must have current work authorization for the United States

Preferred:
• Hands-on experience or interest in LLM APIs (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI)
• Exposure to serverless batch execution or containerization (Docker, AWS Batch, CloudRun)
• Contributions to open-source projects or active personal coding portfolios
